method: Original explosion particle constructors and onUpdate in ParticleProbe.PWorld with stone below y 64 and per-fixture wall/ceiling/web/cactus/farmland/ladder. Math.random raw state before construction and Entity.rand raw state before the constructor recorded for deterministic replay. tracks: position, motion, age, texture index, isDead, onGround. events: huge-emitter World.spawnParticle calls per tick. Burst cases run original client Explosion.doExplosionB(true) on four affected air positions with World.rand seed 19. The TNT case runs EntityTNTPrimed.onUpdate through a three-tick fuse and records the smoke position and the final no-smoke death tick. No classes patched. Render frame/UV formulas are bytecode-derived; no GL renderer run.
